Asset type: one square dialogue portrait for Soul Meter, matching its shipped Wave Z townsfolk.
512×512 neutral bust; semi-realistic painterly dark-fantasy rendering; muted era-3 Dramgid charcoal, blue-black, damp brown, dark iron, pale bone, and restrained tarnished-bronze palette; directional upper-left light; plain dark atmospheric background; ordinary weathered working people; no text, border, magic, glowing eyes, armor spikes, or heroic posing.
Subject: Brannoc Quell, envoy carrying the Watcher's daily reports between the mere and the escarpment elders, lodging in a tent on the approach; has stopped reading them in transit. Lean middle-aged man with weathered olive skin, shoulder-length dark hair tied back, sparse dark beard, rain-worn brown traveling cloak over plain charcoal clothes; guarded weary neutral gaze. Mundane human-looking working courier, no supernatural traits, no Hollow body, no insignia or visible letter.
Composition: single centered head and upper-chest bust, three-quarter view, face large and readable at small dialogue size, modest room above head, hands and props outside crop. Fine naturalistic facial features with restrained painterly texture. Physical details are artistic interpretations, not new canon; record no race except the canon Ghorr steward.
Output: square 512x512 PNG, fully opaque RGB dark atmospheric background.
Avoid: writing, letters, symbols, signage, watermark, decorative frame, faction insignia, regalia, spells, supernatural effects, glowing eyes, Hollow bodies, Ofshütje.

subjects.subject: Corrin Vell, Wayfare Mender instrument-reader posted at the mere's instrument stake, files the Agreement readings alongside the Watcher's sentences. Middle-aged androgynous working person with deep brown weathered skin, closely cropped graying curls, rounded face, plain charcoal linen tunic and brown weather-worn wool shoulder wrap; intent observant neutral expression. No invented instrument, text, magic, religious vestment or faction regalia; plain human-looking appearance.

subjects.subject: Ysolde Marrow, the Widow-Watchers' single observer at the watch-stilt, watches the mere's weather and writes one unsigned sentence daily. Older woman with pale wind-weathered skin, narrow deeply lined face, straight gray hair loosely tied low, plain blue-black hood resting down around shoulders over brown wool clothes; composed tired perceptive neutral gaze, normal dark eyes. Plain human-looking working observer; no magic, prophecy effects, Hollow body or religious regalia.
